items.name: Inquivesta Cube Open 2025

venue.name: MN Saha Auditorium
venue.address: IISER Kolkata, Mohanpur, Nadia - 741246, West Bengal, India

items.information:
* Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate.
* Attend the tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules.
* Bring a government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition.
* Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.

items.name: Big n Blind Bangalore Feb 2025

venue.name: Janma Wellness Club
venue.address: Janma Wellness Club, Ganesha complex, RBI Layout Main Rd, Eswara Layout, JP Nagar 7th Phase, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076

items.information:
* All participants must be present for the entire duration of the competition irrespective of the number of events.

* All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.
 
* Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue.

items.name: Cube Ala-Eh VI 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTcwOTEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--aed6a76524355ef25c004d902de0073ad68c2bfd/Cube_Ala_Eh_VI_Concept_v2_Landscape3_New_Textures.png)
Welcome to sixth iteration of Cube Ala-eh! This competition features the events **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 One-handed, Megaminx**, and **Clock** with **3x3** as the main event.
​
We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.
​
This competition is hosted by Batangas SpeedCubers, a private non-profit organization established with the goal of organizing fun and competitive speedcubing experiences in line with the PCA and WCA vision.

items.name: São Miguel Cubikon 2025
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Information and New Competitor Faq tabs. 

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTc0MjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--a95fa605e7da3f82a2a66b53d08be64613a64ffb/SaoMiguelCubikon2025Logo.png)

items.name: Miami Valley Mini 2025
items.information:
This competition does not have 3x3. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). 


Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/)
